_comment: The tactical battle (wire id 65, open fix 52), work order 197 C. Everything is placed from the battle's own state (open fixes 53-57) and drawn in the original's pictures out of the player's LBX files (tools/combat_art_extract.py); this file carries no geometry, only the markings — one per thing HD does that the original does not, or leaves out. The brief is dev:doc/combat_screen_brief.md, the reading dev:doc/combat_drawing_reading.md.

marks.hd_state: BUILT, NOT ACCEPTED until work order 197's live acceptance is recorded.
marks.hd_extension_free_camera: HD EXTENSION — the field is zoomed by the wheel about the pointer and panned by a right drag, as the galaxy map; the original scrolls its 32 x 18 window by the pointer at the screen's edges (combinit.cpp:2387-2496). The camera starts at the original's framing, 32 cells across round the acting unit.
marks.hd_extension_hd_painted: HD EXTENSION — a painted battle picture in the mod folder may be its stored drawing’s size or a whole k times it; it is drawn at the drawing’s size and place, shrunk smoothly, so its detail shows as the camera zooms in; another size is refused for the game’s drawing. The original draws its 640 x 480 drawings and nothing finer (decision 81, Data, work order 214; cbart._painted, cbdraw.scaled).
marks.hd_extension_painted_detail: HD EXTENSION — Game Settings' painted pictures row holds a painted battle picture at 4 x (Normal) or 8 x (High) at most, shrunk once at load, never enlarged; Auto takes Normal while the battle's opening view is at most 4 x (a field up to 2560 px), High above. The original has no such setting (decision 83, Data, work order 219; core/paintdetail.py, cbart.held, screen._hold_painted).
marks.hd_extension_engine_pulse: HD EXTENSION — a painted battle picture's glow frames are made from its facing's frame 0 (from frame 1 if the modder painted it, whose frame 0 is then his engines-off frame): with an engine mask beside it (<picture's name>_engine.png, greyscale at its size, white = engine; its enclosed holes, the white-hot cores, count as engine) the light under the mask is set to 0.326 x and its colour to grey at frame 0 (engines off), 1 x at frame 1 (the painting), 1.094 x and 1.201 x at frames 2 and 3, each pixel's hue and saturation kept, and frames 2 and 3 glow past the mask out of the ship's back in the engine's own colour, 0.75 and 1 stored-drawing pixel far, at strengths 0.244 and 0.347 fitted so the change over a cycle is the original's (work order 222, decision 8: summed W3C Lum change at the stored size, median of 41 ships); the zone and the glow never coloured by owner or livery; without a mask every frame is frame 0; a painted glow frame wins. The cycle {1,2,3,2} and its 55 ms step are the original's (cbdraw.glow_frame). The original draws four stored frames per facing and makes none (decision 82 as amended by work orders 221 and 222; cbpulse, cbpaint, cbart.ship).
marks.hd_extension_livery: HD EXTENSION — a painted ship may bring livery masks beside its picture (cmbtshp/all_<picture>_<frame>_<pattern>_mask.png, _mask2.png): the first zone's grey takes the owner's colour at full strength in the chosen core variant, the second zone the player's own second colour on his own fleet only; the livery window (GAME -> Settings) chooses pattern, core variant, second colour and strength, applied at a battle's first view. A ship without masks is drawn as Full (219's colour). The original draws eight drawings per ship (decisions 82 amended and 84, Data, work order 220; core/livery.py, cbpaint.livery_recoloured, cbart.CombatArt.set_livery, screen._hold_painted).
marks.transcription_glassed_only: TRANSCRIPTION — a drawing's pixels 0xF0-0xFF blend with what is under them only when the drawing is glassed: its header's ANIMATION_FLAG_GLASSED (animate.cpp:122-160) or Set_Picture_Glassed_ as the battle draws it (the planet's shield flares, beams.cpp:605, :704; the small tractor, cmbtspec.cpp:164); otherwise they are opaque colours of its palette, so the battle's planets are solid (draw.cpp:59-95; work order 219, cbart.glassed).
marks.hd_extension_whole_grid: HD EXTENSION — the whole 81 x 68 field can be on the screen at once; the original shows 32 x 18 cells; both draw the reduced map in the panel (work order 209 B1, cbmap).
marks.deviation_hud_panel: DEVIATION — the acting unit's panel (name, systems, the picture with its shields, weapons or special systems, buttons) is HUD blocks in OrionLayer's words along the bottom, not COMBAT.LBX 0 with its pictures and labels.
marks.deviation_glass_alpha: DEVIATION — a glassed picture's glass pixels (0xF0-0xFF) are drawn at half alpha; the original blends them through a table per effect (animate.cpp:279-287, combinit.cpp:855-989). A picture that is not glassed (the battle's planets) draws them as opaque colours, as the original (work order 219, `cbart.glassed`).
marks.deviation_star_parallax: DEVIATION — the star layers move at 1, 1/2 and 1/8 of the camera; the original's two scroll paths disagree with each other (combinit.cpp:2266-2276, 2458-2482).
marks.deviation_ordnance_stack: DEVIATION — a stack of missiles or fighters is one picture with its count; the original lays up to nine pictures out in its stack patterns (cmbtmis.cpp:735-873).
marks.deviation_untimed_pace: DEVIATION — a loop the original does not time (a missile's or fighter group's flight, a launch flight, the gyro's spin, the plasma web's travel, a teleport, a move's step) runs at a fixed 15 ms a pass by elapsed time, at every frame rate; the original draws one such pass per presented frame, 1.9 ms measured (work order 213), so it has no tempo of its own to match (decision 80, Data, work order 214; cbplay.UNTIMED_S).
marks.transcription_beam_bolt: TRANSCRIPTION — a beam is the original's bolt (bolt.cpp; beams.cpp:2233-2636): the weapon's sixteen colours (Set_Beam_Colors_, :2481-2564, from the table at :1848-2062), its style (thin, wide, continuous, three-layer), the head advancing its step a frame for _max_frames frames, stopped at a third of the shield when it holds, the muzzle burst (BEAMS 1-64) and the hit flash (BEAMS 65/66). Retires work order 197's beam_simplified.
marks.deviation_beam_fire_point: DEVIATION — a beam leaves the shooter's centre; the original starts it at one of the picture's fire points (FIREPTS, not on the wire). The mauler, the breaths, the spatial compressor and weapon 46 are drawn as the same thin bolt in their BEAMS.LBX 0 fragment's colours, not their own renderer.
marks.deviation_number_size: DEVIATION — the damage numbers' digits are 6 world px tall at the camera's scale, never smaller than at the original's framing (32 cells): 18, 24, 36 px at 1080p, 1440p, 4K. The original has no zoom (work order 265, cbnumbers.py).
marks.invention_battle_log: INVENTION — LOG beside OPTIONS opens a window with every hit of the battle (who, what, at whom, the shields' share and the damage through), every loss, retreat and boarding, and what each unit took; the original keeps no log (work order 267, cblog.py).
marks.deviation_event_marks: DEVIATION — a capture, a raid and a special without its own frames here (the anti-missile rocket) are shown as their word over the unit for a moment; the original plays each its own effect.
marks.transcription_pace: TRANSCRIPTION — the events are played at the original's pace: a move 10 frames a cell (HD 0.15 s), a turn one facing per 55 ms frame, an effect one frame per 55 ms (Release_Time_(1)), damage numbers 9 frames rising 1 px a frame (beams.cpp:230-435).
marks.transcription_board_popup: TRANSCRIPTION — the board popup (wire id 67, open fix 66's CPOP): the game's message, the range and the marines chosen as the engine holds them (CMBTDRW1::_g_min/_g_max/_g_var), the two arrows, RAID and CAPTURE as the original's own button fields, ESC as its hotkey (cmbtdrw1.cpp:1581-1666, 2744-2763); an arrow only after the last one's effect arrived, down while the choice is above 0 and up while below the top (:1638-1644).
marks.transcription_scan_contents: TRANSCRIPTION — the scan view (one view since work order 298) shows everything Combat_Draw_View_Ship_ prints (cmbtdrw1.cpp:3223-4007): the combat bonuses, the crew word, marines, drive hits and parsecs a turn, structure, combat speed, armour with the scan's own total, computer hits and its beam attack bonus, the shield's name and hits, its weakest arc as all four arcs, every weapon slot with its count, name, arc, ammunition and mods, and the special systems, a destroyed one coloured; the game's words where KENTEXT.LBX was extracted. Any click but on a row with a card or the slider closes it; a unit that dies closes it (combat1.cpp:952 scans only a living one) (work order 290, screens/combat/cbscan.py).
marks.deviation_scan_view: DEVIATION — the scan view is a HUD window in the shell's look over the dimmed battle, laid out as Data's sketch and mockup of 17 Oct 2026 (ship, officer, crew; shields and combat values; hull and systems, special systems; the weapons across the foot), not COMBAT.LBX 5 with the game's own lines; no weapon or special icons (the game has none) (work order 290, screens/combat/cbscanview.py).
marks.hd_extension_scan_local: HD EXTENSION — HD's SCAN opens its view of the clicked unit without telling the engine: the original's scan changes nothing in the game (it reads a copy, cmbtdrw1.cpp:1550). When the engine itself is in its scan view (under F12), HD draws the unit CPOP names and a click closes it through the view's own exit field.
marks.transcription_special_effects: TRANSCRIPTION — the stasis field, tractor beam, gyro destabilizer, plasma web, black hole, stellar converter, a bomb's flight and impact, a blast round its source and the web on a unit are the original's own frames at their places and pace (cmbtspec.cpp, cmbtfire.cpp:963-1002, cmbtdrw1.cpp:3012-3096).
marks.deviation_texture_line: DEVIATION — a picture drawn along a line (Draw_Bitmap_Line_, bitmap.cpp:298-336: stretched to the line, turned to its angle) is turned by pygame's rotation; the original's own resampling is not traced.
marks.transcription_weapon_rows: TRANSCRIPTION — each weapon row as Draw_Weapon_Status_Display_ writes it (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2765-2933): the shots left, the Hv / Pd prefix, the name for one shot and the plural otherwise, x<ammo> for missiles, bombs, fighters and the anti-missile rocket, <n>t for a recharging torpedo, the arc word in brackets for a beam; the special systems list from the unit's own flags (:543-591); the colours: transcription_row_colours.
marks.deviation_shield_rings: DEVIATION — for the planet (and a unit whose pictures are missing) the shields round its picture in the panel are HD's rings, one per ten points left in each of the four arcs, not the original's box (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2057-2359); every other unit has the original's box since work order 256 (transcription_status_picture).
marks.transcription_status_picture: TRANSCRIPTION — the acting unit's box in the panel as the original's (work order 256, cbstatus.py): Draw_Ship_Status_'s star picture and green shield grown from the unit's outline per arc and strength, Draw_Grey_Damage_Bars_'s armour and structure / internals bars with their grey damage, Draw_Crew_Level_Stars_ (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2057-2359, :948-1139, :1222-1245); held live against the engine's frame in palette indices.
marks.hd_extension_status_painted: HD EXTENSION — a painted unit is drawn at the box's scale over the rings, which keep the stored drawing's outline; the box as large as the panel's room allows (work order 256).
marks.hd_extension_shield_from_painted: HD EXTENSION — variant B of the status box's shield (work order 257), the DEFAULT since work order 258 (Data): the rings round a painted unit are grown by the original's steps from the painted picture's own outline, turned and mirrored for the facing, at the picture's k (rings k pixels thick, the COMBAT.LBX masks k x k per pixel, their steps kept); an unpainted unit keeps the original's rings. ORIONLAYER_SHIELD_OUTLINE=original draws variant A.
marks.deviation_painted_rings: DEVIATION — round a painted unit the panel's shield rings follow the painting's outline, not the stored drawing's (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2057-2359 grows them from the stored drawing); work order 258, Data's decision. An unpainted unit's rings are the original's pixel for pixel.
marks.hd_extension_shield_colours: HD EXTENSION — the status box's ring colours 0x50-0x57 come from screens/combat/assets/shield_colours.json, empty = the game's own colours (the original's pixel match); a mod's file in the player's mod folder replaces them, the green still grown from the outline (work order 258, Data).
marks.transcription_systems_box: TRANSCRIPTION — the systems in their own window as Draw_Internals_Display_ prints them (cmbtdrw1.cpp:360-425): the title (KENTEXT 36), Drive (14) or No Drive (37), Shields (39) or No Shields (38), Computer (21), Structure (16), Armor (18) with their current values right-aligned, then Max Speed (40) and Remaining (90) after a gap; the game's words in its language (work order 258).
marks.transcription_status_words: TRANSCRIPTION — the officer's mark and "Immobile" over the status box are the game's own words in its language, KENTEXT 86 ("(L)", German "(A)") and 0x47 ("Immobile", "Unbeweglich"), read by core/kentext.py (work order 258); HD's font.
marks.omission_status_planet: OMISSION — the planet's box (its picture, its defences' names and its bars, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2068-2129, :958-994) is not built; the planet keeps HD's rings (work order 256).
marks.transcription_status_internals: TRANSCRIPTION (work order 259): a ship's internals bar with its systems hit, as Draw_Grey_Damage_Bars_ draws it — held live on g259_internal_damage, 0 differing — `cbstatus`
marks.transcription_row_colours: TRANSCRIPTION — each weapon row's count and words in the colour Draw_Weapon_Status_Display_ picks (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2765-2846), battle palette: switched on green 0x53, on and able to hit the unit or missile under the pointer bright green 0x56, switched off for one shot or unable to fire (no ammunition, a torpedo recharging, no shots left) yellow 0xDC, switched off red 0x4A; a unit the computer controls all green; the specials red when damaged, green while ready, else yellow (:543-589). Data's decision 2 of work order 209 replaced work order 203's blue bars.
marks.transcription_row_columns: TRANSCRIPTION — the weapon row's count right-aligned at x 127 and its name from x 131 of the original's 114..263 list (Print_Integer_Right_ and Print_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2858, :2929), as fractions of the row's width, so the count stands clear of the row's frame (work order 210 B4).
marks.transcription_teleport: TRANSCRIPTION — a teleport move dissolves the unit out of its cell and into the new one in the same ten frames (five FAST) through Vanish_Bitmap_ and _noise_table (cmbtmov1.cpp:816-886, shear.cpp:24-42, 540-588); HD gives a frame 15 ms where the original’s loop has no wait (DEVIATION untimed_pace, decision 80) (cbcloak, work order 210 C4).
marks.transcription_lightning: TRANSCRIPTION — the Lightning Field: CMBTSFX 0 at the unit’s centre less 36 for 15 ticks, its frames running on from the last field’s (Lightning_Field_, cmbtspec.cpp:216-271), before each missile hit or fighter pass at a unit with a working field (cmbtmis.cpp:312-333); no event names it, HD infers it (HD STATE lightning_inferred, proposed open fix 76) (cbplay, work order 210 C3).
marks.transcription_spherical_sfx: TRANSCRIPTION — Do_Spherical_SFX_ (cmbtspec.cpp:1589-1840) drawn on the event that fires it, every time: Plasma Flux and Pulsar CMBTSFX 0x34, the Spatial Compressor CMBTSFX 6, the source over it; a ship dying in a blast SPHERSFX 0 / 1 with the ship collapsing under it; units in reach shaken by distance and ring (cbblast, work order 210 C3, C4).
marks.deviation_shake_random: DEVIATION — a shaken unit is drawn -2..+2 px off its place; the original takes the numbers from the game’s Random_(5), HD from its own (cbblast, work order 210 C3).
marks.transcription_death_picture: TRANSCRIPTION — a plain death: CMBTSFX 3 / 4 / 5 by size, frames 0..n-1 a tick each, its top-left at the centre less (12, 9) / (23, 20) / (47, 44), the unit gone from frame n / 2 (cmbtspec.cpp:1192-1276) (cbblast, work order 210 C4).
marks.transcription_anti_missile: TRANSCRIPTION — the anti-missile rocket: a 3 x 3 dot in palette 25, corners 16, 20 px a tick (30 FAST) from the source’s centre to the missile, then CMBTSFX 7 at the missile less 12 when it destroyed any (cmbtspec.cpp:686-797, 1395-1408); HD reads the count from the next state (HD STATE anti_missile_count, proposed open fix 75) (cbsfx, work order 210 C3).
marks.transcription_cloak: TRANSCRIPTION — a unit with special_status_flag 1 or 5 drawn through Plasma_Darken_ (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2627-2630, 2935-3006): each pixel remapped through Create_Ship_Darken_Map_ (:2671-2742) by the plasma map COMBAT.LBX 0x31 at (_ship_frame + unit * 2) % 16, darkness 6; for every viewer (cbcloak, work order 210 C1).
marks.transcription_phasing: TRANSCRIPTION — a unit with special_status_flag 4 drawn as its outline in palette index 5 while the acting unit is the local player’s, and not at all otherwise (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2617-2625; Outline_Bitmap_, shear.cpp:131-213) (cbcloak, work order 210 C1).
marks.transcription_cloak_fades: TRANSCRIPTION — Draw_Cloak_’s fades: cloaking 24 steps, uncloaking 24, phasing 60, unphasing 36, a step a tick (two under FAST), each its own darkness rule (cmbtspec.cpp:59-121); HD plays one when the state it adopts changes a unit’s flag (HD STATE cloak_fade_time; cbcloak.Fades, work order 210 C1).
marks.transcription_lasting_overlay: TRANSCRIPTION — what stays on a held unit after its picture, one of three: the stasis ball at 100 %, else the plasma web at _ship_frame % frames, else the black hole at (_ship_frame / 2) % 8 (+ 8 past its first turn) (Draw_Ship_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2641-2653) (cbdraw.lasting_overlay, work order 210 C2).
marks.transcription_lasting_tractor: TRANSCRIPTION — a tractor that holds (special_cooldown names a live unit) drawn as CMBTSFX 2 frame 6 between the centres, under the units (Draw_Continuing_Tractor_, cmbtspec.cpp:140-173; cmbtdrw1.cpp:506-515) (cbdraw.draw_tractors, work order 210 C2).
marks.transcription_reduced_map: TRANSCRIPTION — the reduced map at the panel's right end as Draw_Reduced_Combat_Map_ and Draw_Reduced_Map_Box_ draw it (cmbtdrw1.cpp:1168-1262): the whole field at 3/2 px a cell, the planet, a blip per live unit in its side's ramp, a dot per missile, brackets round the view; a click centres the view there (combat1.cpp:685-686). Work order 209 B1, Data's decision 1.
marks.omission_missile_warning_picture: OMISSION — with MISSILE WARNING on and a missile on its way to a human player's unit the original shows its warning picture in the reduced map's place (cmbtdrw1.cpp:874-878, 1849-1857); the warning is not on the wire, so HD keeps the map.
marks.transcription_tab_words: TRANSCRIPTION — the WEAPONS / SPECIALS words are drawn at the size of the buttons' words: the original's pictures (COMBAT.LBX 7 and 8) carry them at the same 7-row cap height as AUTO ... DONE (COMBAT.LBX 0x32-0x36), in a tab twice the word's cap tall as the picture is (combinit.cpp:688, 697; cmbtdrw1.cpp:1268-1273).
marks.transcription_shield_flare: TRANSCRIPTION — a beam that strikes a shield makes it flare as the original's shot loop does (beams.cpp:437-478, 557-704, 2466-2470): while the bolt's head is inside the shield's square the flare ramps in, loops and plays out; BEAMS 67-86 by size and the hit's rotation folded to five drawings and a flip (109- when pierced, 129- for an enveloping weapon, 133-152 round a planet), the target's picture brightened 30 + 4 j per cent under the flare's glass pixel 0xF0 + j and snapped to the battle palette, the flare drawn over it. Replaces work order 199's omission of it.
marks.transcription_combat_options: TRANSCRIPTION — the OPTIONS button under the battle's buttons and its panel (combat1.cpp:111-178, cmbtdrw1.cpp:1268-1322, 1463-1544): while open fix 68's COPT says the panel is up, its title (the same button, ESC), SELF DESTRUCT and the five lights MISSILE WARNING, FAST ANIMATIONS, SHOW LEGAL MOVES, SHOW SHIELD ARCS, DISPLAY GRID as the battle holds them, each click the original's own field. Replaces work order 199's omission of it.
marks.transcription_option_drawing: TRANSCRIPTION — what the options draw: the grid, a line every 20 px in colour 4 (cmbtdrw1.cpp:528-535); the acting unit's shield arcs, four borders in colour 0x54 and the letters F R B L (A D I S in the Italian game only) in colour 0x81 (Draw_Shield_Arcs_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:21-152); the legal cells from the battle's own flag; FAST ANIMATIONS as the original's steps under _speedx2_flag (a move 12 px a frame, a bolt two frames, the specials every second frame, a retreat every third).
marks.deviation_legal_cells_readable: DEVIATION — the cells a ship may move to (the engine's own, combat_grid == 2000, with the unit's footprint) are drawn over the star layers and under the units as a light tint the stars show through and a lit edge round the reachable area, the same in a nebula. The original fills them solid in palette 0x81, black in a nebula, between its far star layer and the near ones (Draw_Legal_Boxes, cmbtdrw1.cpp:326-376, :364; Full_Draw_Combat_Screen :547-577); on HD's field that dark navy under the stars read as part of the space, not as a marking. Readable on HD graphics (Data, work order 303; screens/combat/cbdraw.py).
marks.transcription_legal_gate: TRANSCRIPTION — when the reachable cells are drawn: Draw_Legal_Boxes' own gate (cmbtdrw1.cpp:327-343, :553-559) — on the player's own turn with SHOW LEGAL MOVES on, never for the planet (unit 0), with moves left, or with none while a working Sub-Space Teleporter or Phase Shifter is unused this turn (Used_Teleporter, bit 0 of combat_status_flags, cmbtfir2.cpp:399-405), when the engine's bitmap holds the teleporter's range (combat1.cpp:2834-2843) (Data, work order 303, P3 of 302; screens/combat/screen.py).
marks.transcription_move_pointer: TRANSCRIPTION — over a cell the acting ship may move to, the pointer is the original's arrow in the move's direction: icon Get_Facing(ship, cell) / 2 + 4, icons 4-11 counter-clockwise from east (Assign_Mouse_Images, combat1.cpp:2282-2296; Get_Facing, cmbtmov1.cpp:573-592), the shapes behind the battle palette in FONTS.LBX entry 4 (fonts.cpp:73-87, shape = icon - 1, platform.cpp:1806-1812), the point the picture's middle (frame 12, mouse.cpp:80-101); HD's own pointer elsewhere (Data, work order 303, P1 of 302; screens/combat/cbcursor.py).
marks.transcription_board_slider: TRANSCRIPTION — the board popup's bar is the original's scroll field (cmbtdrw1.cpp:1602) and dragging it sets the choice as Find_Bar_Position_ does (fields.cpp:1720-1762): the place along the field's 207 px times the range over the width, plus the minimum, held to the range; on release HD clicks the field at the place that gives the shown choice (open fix 3 keeps the injected pointer) and then shows the wire's choice. Replaces work order 199's omission of it.
marks.transcription_release_stasis: TRANSCRIPTION — a click on an enemy held in a stasis field asks to release it (KENTEXT 61, the game’s box in HD’s) and releases it on YES, as the original’s click does (combat1.cpp:782-796, Ship_Is_In_Stasis_ cmbtmov1.cpp:53-58); HD sends open fix 58’s REMOVE_STASIS, the engine refusing a FIRE there (work order 214, cbinput).
marks.transcription_weapon_switch: TRANSCRIPTION — each weapon row is the original's own switch: its hidden field (combat1.cpp:180-183) cycles the slot's active 1 -> 0 -> -1 -> 1 (:594-613); HD clicks it, the next once the change is on the wire, shows the row lit at 1, dimmed at 0, dark at -1 (cmbtdrw1.cpp:2786-2849), and FIRE sends the rows at 1. Only -1 keeps a weapon out of the defensive fire (cmbtfir2.cpp:868-930).
marks.transcription_energy_absorber: TRANSCRIPTION — a unit whose Energy Absorber holds a charge (reflected_damage_pool) glows behind its picture: CMBTSFX 0x33 + (-1 - size) / 2 (one less for size 4) at (ship_frame / 2 + unit) modulo its frames, centred on the unit, not in stasis or under a plasma web (Draw_Energy_Absorber_, cmbtfire.cpp:923-953; Draw_Ship_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2632-2637).
marks.transcription_combat_help: TRANSCRIPTION — a right click on the battle's panel opens the help Set_Combat_Help_Fields_ gives there (combat1.cpp:2402-2590): the buttons 623-628 and OPTIONS 617, or with the OPTIONS panel up SELF DESTRUCT 695 and the lights 696-700; the current ship display 618 (HD's picture) and the systems display 622 (HD's lines of the unit's systems); a weapon row its tech application's entry (a special system's on the specials tab), an empty row the weapons display 629. The reduced map (620/621) has no HD element. screens/combat/cbhelp.py, work order 200.
marks.transcription_reflection: TRANSCRIPTION — a reflection plays as the original's shot loop does (beams.cpp:1480-1530, 1724-1837, 2388-2424; cmbtfire.cpp:1743-1748): the shooter's weapon fired back from the reflector, its tail a third of the reflection field's diameter (29, 52, 71, 86) out, past every shield; the reflection field's flare on the reflector, BEAMS.LBX 0x59 + size * 5 + rotation from the shooter, on at once, four frames in, then out; the reflected damage over the shooter.
marks.transcription_firing: TRANSCRIPTION — one FIRE is one loop: its shots grouped by weapon slot, two entries drawn at a time, the second starting at frame 9, each frame 55 ms, ended when both are done, the flare is off and the numbers have risen (Beam_SFX_, beams.cpp:1312-1712; work order 212, cbshot)
marks.transcription_effect_pace: TRANSCRIPTION — every effect at the source's pace: each loop's Release_Time_(n) per frame, the damage numbers held until done (cmbtspec.cpp:1013, :1549; beams.cpp:495-508; work order 212, cbplay.sfx_times); HD STATE view_pause: no 7-tick pause before a ship off the original's view explodes (cmbtspec.cpp:1175-1178), HD's camera is not that view
marks.transcription_gyro_line: TRANSCRIPTION — the gyro destabilizer's line loops its last three frames while the target turns, eight passes of 2 ticks (cmbtspec.cpp:1511-1549; work order 212, cbsfx)
marks.transcription_web_travel: TRANSCRIPTION — the plasma web's blob travels 6 px a frame from the source to the target, then its impact (Plasma_Web_, cmbtspec.cpp:1060-1140; work order 212, cbsfx)
marks.transcription_sound_player: TRANSCRIPTION — the battle's sounds are the game's own SOUND.LBX, played by HD at the point of its animation the engine names (open fix 79), at the Sound Fx level, faded 10 a tick, looped and pitched as sound.cpp does (work order 212, cbsound)
marks.transcription_flight: TRANSCRIPTION — missiles, torpedoes and fighters fly their path, speed px a pass, turned toward their target, before the hits resolve (Seeking_Missiles_, combat1.cpp:2158-2249; Move_Missile_, cmbtmis.cpp:132-216; work order 212, cbflight)
marks.transcription_fighter_beams: TRANSCRIPTION — a fighter pass fires its owner's point-defence beam from a quarter of the group, from the stack's places, then its number rises (Fighter_Combat_SFX_, cmbtmis.cpp:875-970; open fix 77; work order 212, cbflight)
marks.transcription_multi_beam: TRANSCRIPTION — the Mass Driver and the Gauss Cannon fire three bolts a frame apart with the second muzzle set, the Mauler Device and the breaths three bolts; the last bolt drawn decides the hit and the flare (beams.cpp:856-909, 1155-1179, 1243-1266; work order 212, cbshot)
marks.transcription_mauler_ball: TRANSCRIPTION — the mauler ball BEAMS.LBX 0x58 at a bolt's head until it strikes (beams.cpp:2420-2422; work order 212, cbshot)
marks.transcription_transporter_beam: TRANSCRIPTION — with Transporters a bomb starts near the planet after 8 ticks of CMBTSFX 15 along the line in the stasis bubble's glass (cmbtdrw1.cpp:3024-3040, cmbtspec.cpp:800-854; work order 212, cbsfx)
marks.transcription_missile_frames: TRANSCRIPTION — a missile cycles its first three frames, (_ship_frame + index) % 3, while it is aimed at the acting unit, the Proton Torpedo always; a fighter group while its final target is the acting unit; otherwise frame 0 (Draw_Missile_, cmbtmis.cpp:1130-1136; Draw_Fighter_, :1107-1111; work order 214, cbdraw.ordnance_frame).
marks.transcription_launch_flight: TRANSCRIPTION — a missile leaves its ship flying 12 px a pass to where its launch puts it, the Proton Torpedo and the Dragon Breath the whole way to their target (Missile_Launch_FX_, cmbtspec.cpp:856-948; work order 212, cbflight)
marks.transcription_gyro_spin: TRANSCRIPTION — the gyro destabilizer spins its target as many sixteenths of a turn as the engine drew (19 of Random_(13), then more while it would end 15, 0 or 1 round, cmbtspec.cpp:566-575), on the wire since open fix 83; an engine without it leaves HD STATE gyro_spin, two turns round (work order 213, Data's decision 2)
marks.transcription_specials_list: TRANSCRIPTION — the SPECIALS tab lists the special bits below SPECIAL_REGENERATION, as _amoeba_regeneration is never set (cmbtdrw1.cpp:557-558, combinit.h:11), row after row 11 px apart with no cap (:559-582) (work order 213)
marks.transcription_monster_file: TRANSCRIPTION — a unit built by no player, the Antarans (player 8) as much as a monster (10 and up), is drawn from MONSTER.LBX[picture_num] (picture 44: entry 25); CMBTSHP[colour * 45 + picture_num] only for previous_owner < MAX_PLAYERS (Draw_Ship_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2535-2545; work order 215, cbdraw.from_monster_file).
marks.transcription_monster_glow: TRANSCRIPTION — a monster's picture (previous_owner > 9) runs its four frames in turn, (_ship_frame / 2) % 4, frame 0 included; a player's or an Antaran's the cycle {1, 2, 3, 2} phased by the unit (Draw_Ship_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2499-2508; work order 215, cbdraw.glow_frame).
marks.hd_extension_plating_colour: HD EXTENSION — a painted battle picture under the colour-free name cmbtshp/all_<picture>_<frame>.png serves every owner without a file of its own: its neutral grey (chroma below 0.05, to 0.10 in part, near-white kept) takes the owner's colour by the color blend, keeping light and shade; its colours stay as painted; a missing glow frame is made from the facing's frame 0 (engine_pulse, work order 221), a missing stored facing is turned in code from the nearest given one at 2 x or more, the other eleven mirror and flip the five as the original's. The original draws eight different ships, one per colour (decision 82, Data, work order 216 P1; built by 217, cbpaint).
marks.transcription_dark_engines: TRANSCRIPTION — a unit whose player pressed DONE this turn (bit 0x04 of combat_status_flags, Combat_Ship_Done_, cmbtfir2.cpp:957; set by DONE, combat1.cpp:852; cleared at its side's turn start, combat1.cpp:1270) or that was captured (is_captured, cmbtfir2.cpp:1841-1845) is drawn at frame 0, its engines off, every unit alike (Draw_Ship_, cmbtdrw1.cpp:2563-2610; work order 222, Data's decision 2; cbdraw.engines_off).
marks.transcription_cursor_hidden: TRANSCRIPTION — the acting unit's cursor is not drawn while that unit is moved, turned or teleported, or its cloak fades (_dont_draw_ship, cmbtmov1.cpp:84-85, :321, :836; cmbtspec.cpp:95; tested at cmbtdrw1.cpp:815), nor while the computer controls it (Ship_Controlled_By_Computer_, :817); until work order 222 HD drew it on the cell a move left until the move ended, Data's trailing blue blink (cbplay.dont_draw, screen.py).
marks.hd_extension_painted_outline: HD EXTENSION — a phased painted ship is drawn as the original draws its own (Outline_Bitmap_ then Mask_Out_Bitmap_With_Bitmap_, colour 5, while the acting unit is the local player's; cmbtdrw1.cpp:2617-2625): the ring one stored-drawing pixel wide (k painted pixels, 4-neighbour steps) round its opaque pixels (alpha half or more), the picture masked out. The original's outline reads palette indices, which a painted PNG has not; until work order 222 a phased painted ship was not drawn at all (Data's decision 5; cbcloak.painted_outline).
marks.transcription_field_only: TRANSCRIPTION — a click, a right click and the hover act on the battlefield only where the field is drawn: the original's field is one grid field, (0,0)-(639,359) (combat1.cpp:114), and its panel below holds other fields or none. HD's world goes on under the panel band; a point there is the panel's and never a cell (cbview.Camera.on_field; work order 224, D1).
marks.transcription_auto_off: TRANSCRIPTION (work order 229 F): while the player's side plays under AUTO the engine's list is one full-screen field (_auto_button, combat1.cpp:569-570), which the computer's turn polls (cmbtai.cpp:598, :616, :740); any click in HD sends it and AUTO is off (cbinput.auto_off_field)
marks.transcription_target_box: TRANSCRIPTION (work order 259): the unit or missile under the pointer in the systems window, as the original's box at x 400 (cmbtdrw1.cpp:600-790; Draw_Missile_Status_, cmbtmis.cpp:1383-1437) — `cbtarget`
marks.deviation_target_missile_picture: DEVIATION (work order 259): the missile in its box is HD's one map picture of the group, not the original's group of pictures (Draw_Missile_, cmbtmis.cpp:1130-1180) — `cbtarget`
marks.transcription_absorber_charge: TRANSCRIPTION (work order 259, open fix 94): the Energy Absorber's glow starts where the engine takes the charge — before a FIRE's one Beam_SFX_ loop (cmbtfire.cpp:776-791, 1323, 1461) — `cbqueue.take_firing`
marks.hd_extension_scan_detailed: HD EXTENSION — the scan's additions, for every unit, own and enemy (Data, work order 290; the one view since work order 298, the Normal mode removed): the four shield arcs as numbers with their one shared maximum (no weakest-arc or shield-name line, work order 294), a weapon slot as count/original and the HP of the weapon in front (a hit takes from one weapon at a time, count = ceil(hits / per weapon): cmbtfir2.cpp:1184-1198; Rocco's feedback, 294), a special system's hits (the slots Init_Internal_Space numbers, cmbtfir2.cpp:658-685) and state, the crew's experience. Since work order 297 (Data, from the analysis of 18 Oct 2026): the boxes by what they hold, every cell cut with an ellipsis rather than drawn past its box, every officer combat skill, the weapons as # Weapon Count HP State Arc Ammo Mods, the shield generator with its state in the shields' head and the shield upgrades and a damper field on a tag line under it, four combat values with the computer as Beam Attack's part, combat speed as current / maximum (Maximum_Combat_Speed_, combat1.cpp:12-26), a value's NUMBER coloured orange or red with a sign when a system of this ship behind it is damaged or destroyed. The original scans any living unit for anyone and stores nothing (combat1.cpp:952, cmbtdrw1.cpp:18-29): the same record, finer.
marks.hd_extension_scan_officer: HD EXTENSION — the officer aboard: the Leaders screen's portrait, name, title, level word with the (L) mark, and the skills a battle reads (Engineer, Fighter Pilot, Galactic Lore, Helmsman, Ordnance, Security, Weaponry, Commando: cmbtfir2.cpp:94-180, :475-485, :1866-1910) with the Leaders screen's values; the original's scan only greys the fleet icon (cmbtdrw1.cpp:3313-3326) (work order 290).
marks.hd_extension_scan_identity: HD EXTENSION — the hull class, the owner's race and the design's date from the ship record; the original's scan prints the name over the picture only (work order 290).
marks.invention_scan_turn: INVENTION — the battle's turn (CMBT turn + 1) in the scan's head; the original shows it nowhere (work order 290).
marks.deviation_scan_words: DEVIATION — the scan's labels are the game's KENTEXT lines where the player's file was extracted (core/kentext.py PANEL_MESSAGES), without their bullet and colon; OrionLayer's English otherwise, and its own words for what the original does not print (work order 290).
marks.hd_extension_scan_states: HD EXTENSION — a part's state by colour and word: operational, damaged, destroyed; the original colours only a destroyed special system (cmbtdrw1.cpp:3939-3963) (work order 290).
marks.omission_scan_planet: OMISSION — the planet's scan (unit 0) shows its record's values, not the original's ground-defence line and building shield names (cmbtdrw1.cpp:3578-3593, :3720-3726) (work order 290).
marks.hd_extension_scan_transparency: HD EXTENSION — a slider in the scan's foot lets the battle's space (the star layers over the whole window; no unit, no legal box, no panel, not the shell's background picture) through the window's and the boxes' fills, 0 to 85 %; the edges, words, buttons and pictures stay whole; the player's setting scan_transparency, 0 by default (Data, work order 292).
marks.hd_extension_scan_breakdown: HD EXTENSION — in the scan a combat value under the pointer shows its parts in a card, as the engine adds them (Offensive_Combat_Bonus_ cmbtfir2.cpp:281-300, Defensive_Combat_Bonus_ :175-207, Calc_Current_Speed_ combat1.cpp:1193-1258; orion2re v2's cloak names): this ship's systems one by one, crew, race and own officer as one Base line with its sources, other units' officer, station, Scout Lab or Wide Area Jammer in their own tint and named, combat speed as its formula, a total; counted from the battle as the round's first frame showed it, since the engine adds them up at each round's start (combinit.cpp:1053-1061): a system destroyed or a unit fallen out since with its still-counting value and "counts until end of round", nothing guessed; shown only when the parts make the engine's own sum, else the sum and "Breakdown not available". An info sign marks each row with a card; the same card shows a cut cell's whole text and a "+n more". A combat value's card stands right of COMBAT VALUES, top on the box's top, one rectangle for all four rows, a notch at the hovered row; it may cover the right column and part of WEAPONS; a cut cell's card beside its cell, never over COMBAT VALUES, SPECIAL SYSTEMS or HULL AND SYSTEMS; every card inside the scan window, lying on top (the frame colour's lit edge and glow, a ground darker than the boxes that the transparency never reaches) (Data, work orders 297, 298, screens/combat/cbscanparts.py, cbscancard.py).
marks.deviation_scan_card_click: DEVIATION — in the scan a left click on a row with a card (a combat value, a cut cell, a "+n more") does not close the view; the original's scan closes on any click (cmbtdrw1.cpp:156-247), and every other click still closes HD's (Data, work order 297, screens/combat/cbpopups.py).
marks.deviation_scan_one_view: DEVIATION — the scan is one view that shows more than the original's: everything Combat_Draw_View_Ship_ prints (cmbtdrw1.cpp:3223-4007) and HD's additions (scan_detailed, scan_breakdown) in one window, with the click rule of scan_card_click; the original's scan prints its own lines and closes on any click (cmbtdrw1.cpp:156-247). The Normal / Detailed switch of work orders 290-297 is removed by Data's decision (work order 298: Normal was a subset, switching hid the most useful information, every layout had to hold twice) (screens/combat/cbscanview.py).
marks.transcription_modal_right_click: TRANSCRIPTION — the scan view and the board popup are their own input loops in the original (Detailed_View_Ship_ cmbtdrw1.cpp:156-247, Board_Popup_ :1581-1666); Get_Input_'s cancel is off since the main screen (Disable_Cancel_, fields.cpp:112-114, mainscr_main.cpp:281), so a right click returns the field under it negative (fields.cpp:1375, :1526-1528), which neither loop answers — both compare positive ids — and the battle under them never turns a ship: HD sends no FACE for a right press that starts or ends while one is up (cbinput._right_owner, work order 298).
marks.deviation_scan_right_click: DEVIATION — the original's scan and board popup keep the battle's help list (the scan saves it and does not clear it, Save_Help_List_ evanhelp.cpp:356-360; the board popup never touches it, Clear_Fields_ fields.cpp:212-223 leaves it) and Check_Help_List_ runs before the fields (fields.cpp:1255, :1379), so by the source a right click over a battle help region opens that help over either (read, not seen live); HD's scan and board popup consume every right click and right drag: no help, no FACE, no pan, no pin (Data, work order 298, P1 of 297). The battle log and the help panel stop a right drag the same way; the help panel's right click still closes it.
marks.transcription_options_right_click: TRANSCRIPTION — while the battle's OPTIONS panel is up a right click on the field turns no ship: the original adds no space field then (_space_field = -100, combat1.cpp:155, against :111-114), so its right click never reaches Turn_To_Face_ (:702); HD sends no FACE. A right drag stays HD's camera (free_camera) (Data, work order 299, P1 of 298; screens/combat/cbinput.py).
marks.transcription_scan_wheel: TRANSCRIPTION — while the scan is up the mouse wheel is the scan's and never zooms the battle under it: the original's scan is its own input loop with no zoom (Detailed_View_Ship_ cmbtdrw1.cpp:156-247) (Data, work order 299, P7 of 298; screens/combat/cbinput.py).
marks.deviation_scan_crew_level_5: DEVIATION — a crew level above the crew table's last row (Calc_Ship_Level_ caps at 5 after the Warlord's +1, ericnet.cpp:217-236; _crew_data rows 0-4, mox.cpp:780-786) has no word in the original: Crew_Quality_String_ falls to its default and prints nothing (cmbtdrw1.cpp:3850-3851). HD's scan names the highest known level (Ultra Elite) instead of an empty word, its stars still five as the original's (cmbtdrw1.cpp:1222-1245); open fix 100 registers the level as an observation (Data, work order 299, P5 of 298; screens/combat/cbscan.py).
marks.deviation_scan_computer_line: DEVIATION — the original's scan prints the computer's beam attack bonus as its own line under the computer, or "no bonus" at 0 hits (KENTEXT 0x16/0x17, cmbtdrw1.cpp:3593-3606). HD's view leaves the line out and shows the bonus as the computer's line in Beam Attack's card (scan_breakdown): only under the pointer, and only when the parts make the engine's sum. Data, work order 301: the card shows every part; a single sub-line showed one part as if it were the only one (screens/combat/cbscan.py).
marks.deviation_scan_galaxy_speed: DEVIATION — the original's scan prints the drive type's galaxy speed, "^ n parsecs/turn" (KENTEXT 15), under the drive's hits, above the combat speed (v2 cmbtdrw1.cpp:3548-3567 with the trans-dimensional bonus, Get_FTL_Speed; 1.60 :3428-3440). HD shows it as the last line of Combat speed's card, under its own separator: only under the pointer. Nothing in a battle reads the galaxy speed; beside the drive's hits it read as the damaged drive's speed (Data, work order 302, P1 of 301; screens/combat/cbscancard.py).
marks.hd_extension_scan_hull_cards: HD EXTENSION — each HULL AND SYSTEMS row (structure, armour, drive, computer) has an info sign and a card under the pointer that says what damage to that part does, from the engine's rules: armour first and what skips it (Select_Internal, cmbtfir2.cpp:1168-1230), the drive's speed over its upper half in whole numbers (Calc_Current_Speed, combat1.cpp:1355-1392), no retreat and boarding at speed 0, the explosion at 0 hits (Is_Combat_Ship_Dead, cmbtfire.cpp:310-326), the computer all or nothing (Computer_Bonus, cmbtfir2.cpp:275-281). The card stands left of the box and never covers its row, its notch at the row. The original's scan explains nothing (Data, work order 302, P7 of 301; screens/combat/cbscan.py).
marks.hd_extension_scan_hover: HD EXTENSION — in SCAN mode the systems window shows the unit under the pointer as the target box does, the unit only, no missile; the original's scan pointer (picture 13, combat1.cpp:1785-1790) shows nothing there (Data, 17 Oct 2026) — `cbinput._target`
